Validation is tied at 0.1559 across lambda in {1e-4, 1e-3, 1e-2, 1e-1}; the 0.0215 spread comes only from the two high-lambda arms. argmax therefore picked an arbitrary member of a tie. This is the recorded 'validate the selector, not only the selection' defect, reproduced here.

part_2_strace_reduction.trigger: Two same-class ingress repair failures, both below the legacy baseline: plain-mean aggregation 0.0840 and phase-gain / learned-position-embedding best 0.0996, versus legacy 0.1002.
part_2_strace_reduction.method: Freeze the representation; swap only the readout. Five heads at identical budgets, each frozen feature set with its own shuffled-label control.
findings: RANK IS NOT THE BINDING CONSTRAINT. The order repair raised effective rank 10.29 -> 162.21 (15.8x) and top-10 eigenvalue share fell 0.8554 -> 0.3010, yet held-out accuracy FELL slightly (0.0984 -> 0.0922). A richer spectrum did not convert into accuracy.

READOUT CAPACITY IS NOT THE BINDING CONSTRAINT. No head in the five tested families on any representation exceeds its own shuffled control by more than 0.0253, and the best absolute value on any cortical representation is 0.0984.
THE SIGNAL IS TOO WEAK AT THIS TRAINING BUDGET (336 training rows). Every head family lands within 0.008 of the unigram floor 0.0782 or below it.

ONE REAL SUB-EFFECT: on cortical_gain4 the nearest-centroid head scored 0.0762 versus 0.02 on legacy -- the corrected representation does carry class structure that the legacy wave does not. It is not yet strong enough to clear the floor.
part_2_strace_reduction.verdict: STRACE_REDUCTION_COMPLETE. The reduced signature is: normalisation/readout/rank all excluded as the primary constraint; the limit is the strength of the signal available from this ingress at this budget.
part_2_strace_reduction.no_further_patch: Per the workflow, no further ingress patch is applied before this reduction. It is now recorded, so a future patch must address the identified locus and not re-try rank, pooling, position coding, or regularisation.
